title: Lost Mary Maryliq Peach Strawberry Watermelon Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Indulge in the luxurious fruit medley of Lost Mary Maryliq's Peach Strawberry Watermelon Ice. This e-liquid goes beyond offering a perfect blend of succulent Peach, ripe Strawberry, and juicy Watermelon; it accents each inhale with a refreshing Ice finish. Imagine biting into a chilled fruit salad but elevated to a whole new level of satisfaction. Perfect for hot summer days or whenever you need a burst of fruity freshness, this e-liquid offers an incredible complexity that keeps your palate guessing. A balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio ensures you enjoy a perfect balance between flavour richness and vapour production, all while enjoying a satisfyingly smooth throat hit.
